apps/web/src/components/ThemeProvider.js.description: App-wide theme provider. Hydrates the theme state from localStorage on mount.

apps/web/src/components/actionItems/Acti.description: Card component for tasks/action items. Displays priority color coding, linked goals, assignee, and due dates. Used in both Kanban and List views.
Modal for creating and editing action items. Includes fields for title, description, priority, status, assignee, and goal linkage.
Table-based list view for action items. Provides a dense overview of all tasks sorted by status.

apps/web/src/components/actionItems/Kanb.description: Interactive Kanban board using @dnd-kit. Orchestrates drag-and-drop movement of action items between status columns.
A single column in the Kanban board. Handles droppable area and sortable context for action item cards.

apps/web/src/components/actionItems/View.description: Segmented control for switching between Kanban and List views. Updates the URL 'view' search parameter.

apps/web/src/components/analytics/Export.description: Row of buttons for exporting workspace data to CSV. Gated by EXPORT_CSV capability.

apps/web/src/components/analytics/GoalCo.description: Bar chart visualization using Recharts. Shows a 6-month trend of goals created vs. completed.

apps/web/src/components/analytics/StatsT.description: Composite overview stats component. Features a large weekly 'Action Items Shipped' metric and a goal-status progress bar.

apps/web/src/components/announcements/An.description: Primary display for announcements. Features pinning logic, rich-text rendering, reactions, and threaded comments toggle.
Rich-text editor for announcements using TipTap. Supports @-mentions via a custom extension and workspace member hydration.

apps/web/src/components/announcements/Co.description: Threaded comment list for announcements. Includes a mention-capable textarea for adding new comments.

apps/web/src/components/announcements/Re.description: Real-time reaction picker and counter. Allows users to toggle emojis on announcements.

apps/web/src/components/announcements/Ri.description: Safe renderer for HTML content. Uses Tailwind Typography plugin for consistent styling.

apps/web/src/components/brand/LogoMark.j.description: The official Team Hub logo component. Vector-based with gradient branding.

apps/web/src/components/goals/GoalActivi.description: Vertical timeline of activity for a specific goal. Fetches audit logs from the API.

apps/web/src/components/goals/GoalCard.j.description: Card preview for a goal. Shows progress percentage based on completed milestones.

apps/web/src/components/goals/GoalFormMo.description: Form for goal creation/editing. Manages title, description, owner, and due dates.

apps/web/src/components/goals/MilestoneL.description: Interactive checklist of milestones for a goal. Supports range-based progress tracking and removal.

apps/web/src/components/mentions/Mention.description: Portal-rendered dropdown for member mentions. Shared by TipTap and plain textarea composers.
Custom textarea with @-mention typeahead support. Coordinates caret position and filters members.

apps/web/src/components/ui/Button.jsx.description: Base button component with multiple variants (primary, ghost, contrast) and sizes. Supports loading states and icons.

apps/web/src/components/ui/CommandPalett.description: Global search and action interface (Cmd+K). Powered by cmdk and Radix UI. Provides quick navigation and creation shortcuts.
